title: Score Olivia Rodrigo Concert Tickets Without Breaking the Bank!
summary: Olivia Rodrigo is hitting the road this fall for her Unraveled Tour, and you don't want to miss it! She'll play more than 50 shows across the U.S., starting September 25 in Hartford, Connecticut, and ending with a 10-concert party in Brooklyn, New York, in February 2027. Then she heads to Europe! Her new album, You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love, drops on June 12. Cool opening acts like Wolf Alice and The Last Dinner Party will join her. But here's the thing: tickets are selling out fast! If you missed the first sale, don't worry. You can still find tickets on websites like StubHub, SeatGeek, and Vivid Seats. Prices start as low as $141 on Vivid Seats. That's a deal! These sites guarantee your tickets are real, and you get them sent to your phone instantly. So grab your chance to see Olivia live before it's too late!
why_it_matters: Going to live concerts is an exciting experience, and learning about how to safely buy tickets can help you and your family plan a fun night out without getting scammed.
